data.instruction: Select each objective to explore what it addresses.

back.text: Protect people from hazards such as falls, fires and structural failures.
Protect occupants from health hazards, including unsafe air, water and sanitation.
Help people with disabilities enter, use and navigate buildings.

front.heading: Fire and structural protection of buildings

back.text: Limit damage to buildings and neighbouring properties from fires and structural failures.
Reduce environmental impacts, including unnecessary energy and water use.
